review_state: fitted C92 position photo-registered by assembly geometry and two owner views; marking and electrical rails unproved
source_context: The assembly draws horizontal C92 right of the vertical R4/R2/VD1 stack and above C31. Exact sheet-1 X8 supply detail draws C92 separately from ground to -12 V, despite the nearby collective C82...C93 text beside the +5 V/GND bypass symbol. The explicit C92 branch controls its rail assignment.
source_crossover_review: Native sheet-1 PXL_20260718_101827714.jpg crop (1150,450)-(2700,1500) shows C93's lower lead ending with a junction dot on the +12 V/B line. C92's lower lead passes that +12 V/B line without a junction dot and ends with a dot on the lower -12 V/C line; its upper lead joins ground. This visible crossover is the reason the two adjacent capacitors must not be assigned the same lower rail.
body_marking_recheck: Native July owner crops 200439607 (1150,2070)-(1520,2220) and 200450127 (1360,1650)-(1760,1820) both expose the same red molded body. The dark legend lies on its curved, glare-covered front face. Autocontrast and enlargement recover strokes but no complete numeric or unit code; neither view supports a value transcription. A lower-angle physical view or isolated capacitance measurement is needed.

owner_body.observation: A red molded horizontal axial body occupies the matching strip between the reset stack and C31 in two overlapping owner photographs. It carries dark printed characters, not discernible color bands, but the characters cannot be read reliably from either photograph. A separate lower glass axial body is in a different row and is not this candidate.

visible_copper_limit: The red body's left joint runs into a front trace that bends left under the neighboring upper can area; its right joint joins a vertical front trace. A separate open annulus near (1230,2090) caps the wide strip from D105's bottom-right contact, which is pin 14 with the visible notch-right orientation and +5 V in the source board netlist. The red left joint near (1225,2145) is about 55 px below that annulus with a visible front-side copper gap; do not merge the two by proximity. The adjacent can's visible terminal lead runs below the C92-left horizontal trace with brown clearance; any hidden under-body contact is unproved. The component side proves neither red-body joint to the source C92 rails GND and -12 V.

right_joint_front_strip_review.observation: The C92 right solder joint near (1465,2145) lies directly on a continuous narrow F.Cu vertical strip. The same strip reaches the lower lead of a small green dipped body above C92 and ends at an open annulus below the red body. The green body's upper lead and reference identity are not established by this crop. This is a photographed local shared node, not a proved -12 V rail.
right_joint_front_strip_review.next_test: With power off, probe C92's right lead, the green body's lower lead, and the lower open annulus as one candidate node; then check that node against X8 -12 V and ground. Identify the green body separately before using its value or presumed function.

may_red_green_crosscheck.observation: The independent oblique May view shows the same red C92-position body and the same green dipped body beside the marked IC. A continuous exposed front strip runs from one red lead joint diagonally toward the green body's near/lower lead joint, repeating the July local node from a rotated view. The green body's opposite lead goes to a separate visible joint, and neither photographed lead reaches a marked -12 V or ground terminal within this crop.
may_red_green_crosscheck.body_marking_limit: A native May enlargement exposes dark strokes on the red curved body, but they do not form a reliable capacitance or resistor code and cannot by themselves distinguish C92 from a nearby resistor if the assembly-to-photo placement is wrong. Keep the C92 physical identity assembly-supported and value open until endpoint measurement or a clearer marking view.

green_body_reference_exclusion: The green dipped body sharing C92's right front strip is the rectangular part beside the neighboring DIP in May photo 202052986. It is distinct from the small green axial body between C32 and C33 that the exact .009 assembly and July power-corner crop identify as C93; see c93-power-corner-candidate-review.json. The broader .009 assembly puts R19 to C92's right, but this rectangular body's posture and photographed offset do not by themselves establish R19. Keep its reference, value, and opposite lead net unassigned.

green_body_r19_hypothesis.source_observation: Exact .009 sheet 1 puts C92's lower plate and R19=470 ohm upper/input lead on the same -12 V conductor with filled junctions. R19's opposite lead reaches the -5 V derived node at VD5 before its grounded zener return. This is a specific two-net test for the green part if C92's photographed right lead is its source -12 V plate.
green_body_r19_hypothesis.photo_basis: The green dipped body's near/lower lead is front-copper joined to the C92-position red body's right lead in independent May and July owner views; the assembly places R19 to C92's right. The green far/upper lead ends at a separate visible joint. Its body form and partial dark print do not establish 470 ohms or a reference by themselves.
green_body_r19_hypothesis.discriminator: With power off, test the shared red/green node to X8 -12 V and the green far lead to VD5.2/D1.11/E5.1 derived -5 V. Check isolation from C92's opposite lead/ground and measure the green part in isolation if in-circuit paths obscure 470 ohms. Promote R19 only if both endpoints and value agree; otherwise treat it as an unidentified fitted part or board modification.

decision: The red molded axial body is the fitted component at the unique C92 assembly position, right of R4/R2/VD1 and above C31, corroborated by two overlapping owner views. Register its physical C92 position. Its unreadable marking and both rail joins remain open; if continuity contradicts the exact C92 ground/-12 V branch, investigate a board change or misregistration before assigning the replica pads. Do not classify C92 as DNP.
next_inspection: With power removed, meter the red body leads near (1225,2145)/(1465,2145) to known ground and -12 V at X8. Include the green body's lower lead and the open annulus below C92's right joint as local same-node checks; test its opposite lead to VD5.2/D1.11/E5.1 to discriminate the exact-source R19 470-ohm path. Separately check C92's left lead against D105.14/+5 V at the nearby annulus (1230,2090); the visible front gap does not prove through-board isolation. Test the leftward trace against the adjacent can lead rather than assuming they join under its body. Read the body marking under better light or magnification.
